dict.string: Cuplivo 需要访问日历，以便 AI 助手在您启用日历工具时查询和创建日程；数据在设备上处理，我们不会收集这些信息。 / Cuplivo needs calendar access so the AI assistant can query and create events when you enable the calendar tools; data is processed on-device and Cuplivo does not collect this information.

Cuplivo 需要访问日历，以便 AI 助手在您启用日历工具时查询和创建日程；数据在设备上处理，我们不会收集这些信息。 / Cuplivo needs calendar access so the AI assistant can query and create events when you enable the calendar tools; data is processed on-device and Cuplivo does not collect this information.
Cuplivo 需要使用相机拍摄照片，以便您将图片发送给 AI 助手进行分析。您可以选择是否上传照片。 / Cuplivo uses the camera to capture photos that you can share with AI assistants for analysis. Your photo may be uploaded by your choice.
Cuplivo 使用麦克风录制您主动提交的语音并转换为文字；我们不会收集这些信息。 / Cuplivo uses the microphone to record audio you choose to submit for transcription; Cuplivo does not collect this information.

Cuplivo 使用系统语音识别将您主动录制的语音转换为文字。您的数据由系统处理；我们不会收集这些信息。 / Cuplivo uses system speech recognition to turn audio you choose to record into text. Your data is processed by the system; Cuplivo does not collect this information.
允许保存图片到相册，您的数据将保存在本地。/ Allow saving images to your photo library.Your data will be saved locally.
允许访问相册以选择头像图片 / Allow access to your photos to pick an avatar.
Cuplivo uses your location in the background to keep agent tasks running while the app is not in the foreground.
Cuplivo uses background location to keep agent tasks running when the app is in the background. Location data is used for keep-alive only and is not stored.
